title: Cao Cao: A Literary Youth in a Turbulent Age
synopsis: Cao Cao is renowned for being a cunning strategist and a formidable warlord, but he was also a skilled poet and patron of the arts. Read extracts from his works and explore his more cultured side in this lesson.

fullText.simplified:
曹操——卷入乱世的文艺青年

    曹操是中国历史上非常有名的人物。他是三国时期的政治家、军事家，同时也是一位诗人。在很多人心中，他是一个聪明、有野心，但又让人害怕的人。然而，如果我们从诗人的角度来看曹操，就能发现他不一样的一面——一个热爱文学、关心百姓的文人。
    曹操出生于公元155年。小时候，他就非常聪明，经常能骗过身边的朋友，所以大家叫他“曹阿瞒”。他喜欢读兵书、练武术，也喜欢帮助别人解决问题，在当地小有名气。二十岁时，他去洛阳做官，负责管理城市的治安。他工作认真，但是在朝廷里，很多官员喜欢用钱和关系来换取职位，这让曹操感到失望。后来，他几次被提升，又几次被免职，这就是他年轻时的仕途经历。
    曹操三十多岁时，东汉王朝已经非常混乱了，一个叫董卓的大臣控制了皇帝，百姓的生活越来越困难。曹操用自己的钱组织了一支军队，想要打败董卓。但战争并不顺利，国家依旧很乱。看到战乱给百姓带来的痛苦，曹操非常伤心，写下了一首著名的诗——《蒿里行》，其中的一段是：“白骨露于野，千里无鸡鸣。生民百遗一，念之断人肠。”意思是：田野上到处都是战死人的白骨，千里之内连鸡叫声都听不到；百姓几乎都死光了，想到这些让人感到非常悲伤。这首诗表达了曹操对战争的痛恨，也让他更加坚定地想要统一国家，让百姓过上和平的生活。
    五十多岁时，曹操已经成为了北方最有权力的人。他帮助皇帝管理国家，打败了很多对手，最终统一了北方。有些人说他是坏人，因为他让皇帝听自己的话，但他认为自己是在拯救国家，让百姓过上安定的生活。
    在一次战争后，曹操来到大海边，看到辽阔的大海，心情非常激动。他写下了另一首有名的诗——《观沧海》，其中的一段是："日月之行，若出其中；星汉灿烂，若出其里。"这首诗描述了大海的壮观景色，同时也表现了曹操伟大的理想和坚定的信心。他希望自己能像大海一样广阔，带领国家走向和平。
    曹操不仅自己喜欢写诗，还鼓励别人写文章、作诗。他支持文人，并让很多优秀的诗人加入自己的团队，比如孔融、陈琳等。他们的作品风格非常独特，被称为“建安风骨”，表达了那个时代人们的悲伤和英雄精神。
    曹操的诗歌不像以前的辞赋那么复杂，而是语言简洁、生动，富有节奏感。他的诗歌不仅影响了当时的文学，还对后来的唐诗产生了很大的影响。
    曹操去世后，很多人对他有不同的看法。有人说他是奸臣，因为他掌握了皇帝的权力；也有人说他是英雄，因为他帮助国家统一了北方，减少了战争。他既是战场上的英雄，也是诗歌中的文人，既用军队改变历史，也用诗歌表达情感。或许，如果曹操可以选择自己的时代，他更愿意生在唐朝，做一个像李白那样的真正的诗人，不用打仗，而是自由地写诗、喝酒、游玩。
    无论人们如何评价，曹操的诗歌和成就都被历史铭记。他不仅是一个军事家、政治家，更是一位真正的文艺青年。

曹操——捲入亂世的文藝青年

    曹操是中國歷史上非常有名的人物。他是三國時期的政治家、軍事家，同時也是一位詩人。在很多人心中，他是一個聰明、有野心，但又讓人害怕的人。然而，如果我們從詩人的角度來看曹操，就能發現他不一樣的一面——一個熱愛文學、關心百姓的文人。
    曹操出生於公元155年。小時候，他就非常聰明，經常能騙過身邊的朋友，所以大家叫他“曹阿瞞”。他喜歡讀兵書、練武術，也喜歡幫助別人解決問題，在當地小有名氣。二十歲時，他去洛陽做官，負責管理城市的治安。他工作認真，但是在朝廷裡，很多官員喜歡用錢和關係來換取職位，這讓曹操感到失望。後來，他幾次被提昇，又幾次被免職，這就是他年輕時的仕途經歷。
    曹操三十多歲時，東漢王朝已經非常混亂了，一個叫董卓的大臣控制了皇帝，百姓的生活越來越困難。曹操用自己的錢組織了一支軍隊，想要打敗董卓。但戰爭並不順利，國家依舊很亂。看到戰亂給百姓帶來的痛苦，曹操非常傷心，寫下了一首著名的詩——《蒿里行》，其中的一段是：“白骨露於野，千里無雞鳴。生民百遺一，念之斷人腸。”意思是：田野上到處都是戰死人的白骨，千里之內連雞叫聲都聽不到；百姓幾乎都死光了，想到這些讓人感到非常悲傷。這首詩表達了曹操對戰爭的痛恨，也讓他更加堅定地想要統一國家，讓百姓過上和平的生活。
    五十多歲時，曹操已經成為了北方最有權力的人。他幫助皇帝管理國家，打敗了很多對手，最終統一了北方。有些人說他是壞人，因為他讓皇帝聽自己的話，但他認為自己是在拯救國家，讓百姓過上安定的生活。
    在一次戰爭後，曹操來到大海邊，看到遼闊的大海，心情非常激動。他寫下了另一首有名的詩——《觀滄海》，其中的一段是："日月之行，若出其中；星漢燦爛，若出其裡。"這首詩描述了大海的壯觀景色，同時也表現了曹操偉大的理想和堅定的信心。他希望自己能像大海一樣廣闊，帶領國家走向和平。
    曹操不僅自己喜歡寫詩，還鼓勵別人寫文章、作詩。他支持文人，並讓很多優秀的詩人加入自己的團隊，比如孔融、陳琳等。他們的作品風格非常獨特，被稱為“建安風骨”，表達了那個時代人們的悲傷和英雄精神。
    曹操的詩歌不像以前的辭賦那麼複雜，而是語言簡潔、生動，富有節奏感。他的詩歌不僅影響了當時的文學，還對後來的唐詩產生了很大的影響。
    曹操去世後，很多人對他有不同的看法。有人說他是奸臣，因為他掌握了皇帝的權力；也有人說他是英雄，因為他幫助國家統一了北方，減少了戰爭。他既是戰場上的英雄，也是詩歌中的文人，既用軍隊改變歷史，也用詩歌表達情感。或許，如果曹操可以選擇自己的時代，他更願意生在唐朝，做一個像李白那樣的真正的詩人，不用打仗，而是自由地寫詩、喝酒、遊玩。
    無論人們如何評價，曹操的詩歌和成就都被歷史銘記。他不僅是一個軍事家、政治家，更是一位真正的文藝青年。

sentences.traditional: 在一次戰爭後，曹操來到大海邊，看到遼闊的大海，心情非常激動。

sentences.simplified: 他写下了另一首有名的诗——《观沧海》，
sentences.traditional: 他寫下了另一首有名的詩——《觀滄海》，
sentences.pinyin: tā xiě xià le lìng yī shǒu yǒu míng de shī guān cāng hǎi
sentences.english: After one war, Cao Cao went to the seaside and, seeing the vast ocean, felt very stirred.

sentences.simplified: 其中的一段是："日月之行，若出其中；星汉灿烂，若出其里。"
sentences.traditional: 其中的一段是："日月之行，若出其中；星漢燦爛，若出其裡。"
sentences.pinyin: qí zhōng de yí duàn shì rì yuè zhī xíng ruò chū qí zhōng xīng hàn càn làn ruò chū qí lǐ
sentences.english: He wrote another famous poem, “Viewing the Ocean”.

sentences.simplified: 这首诗描述了大海的壮观景色，同时也表现了曹操伟大的理想和坚定的信心。
sentences.traditional: 這首詩描述了大海的壯觀景色，同時也表現了曹操偉大的理想和堅定的信心。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shǒu shī miáo shù le dà hǎi de zhuàng guān jǐng sè tóng shí yě biǎo xiàn le cáo cāo wěi dà de lǐ xiǎng hé jiān dìng de xìn xīn
sentences.english: This includes the lines: “The sun and moon’s journey seems to emerge from it; the Milky Way is brilliant, as if coming from within.”

sentences.simplified: 他希望自己能像大海一样广阔，带领国家走向和平。
sentences.traditional: 他希望自己能像大海一樣廣闊，帶領國家走向和平。
sentences.pinyin: tā xī wàng zì jǐ néng xiàng dà hǎi yí yàng guǎng kuò dài lǐng guó jiā zǒu xiàng hé píng
sentences.english: This poem describes the magnificent scenery of the sea, while also expressing Cao Cao’s grand ideals and steadfast confidence.
He hoped to be as vast as the ocean, leading the country towards peace.

sentences.simplified: 曹操不仅自己喜欢写诗，还鼓励别人写文章、作诗。
sentences.traditional: 曹操不僅自己喜歡寫詩，還鼓勵別人寫文章、作詩。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo bù jǐn zì jǐ xǐ huan xiě shī hái gǔ lì bié ren xiě wén zhāng zuò shī

sentences.simplified: 他支持文人，并让很多优秀的诗人加入自己的团队，比如孔融、陈琳等。
sentences.traditional: 他支持文人，並讓很多優秀的詩人加入自己的團隊，比如孔融、陳琳等。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī chí wén rén bìng ràng hěn duō yōu xiù de shī rén jiā rù zì jǐ de tuán duì bǐ rú kǒng róng chén lín děng
sentences.english: Cao Cao not only enjoyed writing poetry himself, but also encouraged others to write essays and compose poems.

sentences.simplified: 他们的作品风格非常独特，被称为“建安风骨”，
sentences.traditional: 他們的作品風格非常獨特，被稱為“建安風骨”，
sentences.pinyin: tā men de zuò pǐn fēng gé fēi cháng dú tè bèi chēng wéi jiàn ān fēng gǔ
sentences.english: He supported scholars and recruited many outstanding poets to join his team, such as Kong Rong and Chen Lin.

sentences.simplified: 表达了那个时代人们的悲伤和英雄精神。
sentences.traditional: 表達了那個時代人們的悲傷和英雄精神。
sentences.pinyin: biǎo dá le nà ge shí dài rén men de bēi shāng hé yīng xióng jīng shén
sentences.english: The style of their works is very unique and is known as the “Jian’an style”.
They express the sorrow and heroic spirit of the people of that era.

sentences.simplified: 曹操的诗歌不像以前的辞赋那么复杂，
sentences.traditional: 曹操的詩歌不像以前的辭賦那麼複雜，
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo de shī gē bú xiàng yǐ qián de cí fù nà me fù zá

sentences.simplified: 而是语言简洁、生动，富有节奏感。
sentences.traditional: 而是語言簡潔、生動，富有節奏感。
sentences.pinyin: ér shì yǔ yán jiǎn jié shēng dòng fù yǒu jié zòu gǎn
sentences.english: Cao Cao’s poetry is not as complex as the rhapsody form which came earlier, ..

sentences.simplified: 他的诗歌不仅影响了当时的文学，还对后来的唐诗产生了很大的影响。
sentences.traditional: 他的詩歌不僅影響了當時的文學，還對後來的唐詩產生了很大的影響。
sentences.pinyin: tā de shī gē bù jǐn yǐng xiǎng le dāng shí de wén xué hái duì hòu lái de táng shī chǎn shēng le hěn dà de yǐng xiǎng
sentences.english: .. but rather features concise, vivid language and a strong sense of rhythm.
His poetry not only influenced the literature of his own time but also had a significant influence on Tang poetry, which came later.

sentences.simplified: 曹操去世后，很多人对他有不同的看法。
sentences.traditional: 曹操去世後，很多人對他有不同的看法。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo qù shì hòu hěn duō rén duì tā yǒu bù tóng de kàn fǎ

sentences.simplified: 有人说他是奸臣，因为他掌握了皇帝的权力；
sentences.traditional: 有人說他是奸臣，因為他掌握了皇帝的權力；
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén shuō tā shì jiān chén yīn wèi tā zhǎng wò le huáng dì de quán lì
sentences.english: After Cao Cao’s death, many people had different views about him.

sentences.simplified: 也有人说他是英雄，因为他帮助国家统一了北方，减少了战争。
sentences.traditional: 也有人說他是英雄，因為他幫助國家統一了北方，減少了戰爭。
sentences.pinyin: yě yǒu rén shuō tā shì yīng xióng yīn wèi tā bāng zhù guó jiā tǒng yī le běi fāng jiǎn shǎo le zhàn zhēng
sentences.english: Some say he was a treacherous minister because he seized power from the emperor.

sentences.simplified: 他既是战场上的英雄，也是诗歌中的文人，既用军队改变历史，也用诗歌表达情感。
sentences.traditional: 他既是戰場上的英雄，也是詩歌中的文人，既用軍隊改變歷史，也用詩歌表達情感。
sentences.pinyin: tā jì shì zhàn chǎng shang de yīng xióng yě shì shī gē zhōng de wén rén jì yòng jūn duì gǎi biàn lì shǐ yě yòng shī gē biǎo dá qíng gǎn
sentences.english: Others say he was a hero because he helped unify the north of the country, reducing warfare.

sentences.simplified: 或许，如果曹操可以选择自己的时代，他更愿意生在唐朝，做一个像李白那样的真正的诗人，
sentences.traditional: 或許，如果曹操可以選擇自己的時代，他更願意生在唐朝，做一個像李白那樣的真正的詩人，
sentences.pinyin: huò xǔ rú guǒ cáo cāo kě yǐ xuǎn zé zì jǐ de shí dài tā gèng yuàn yì shēng zài táng cháo zuò yí ge xiàng lǐ bái nà yàng de zhēn zhèng de shī rén
sentences.english: He was a hero on the battlefield and a scholar in poetry, changing history with his army and expressing his emotions through poetry.

sentences.simplified: 不用打仗，而是自由地写诗、喝酒、游玩。
sentences.traditional: 不用打仗，而是自由地寫詩、喝酒、遊玩。
sentences.pinyin: bú yòng dǎ zhàng ér shì zì yóu de xiě shī hē jiǔ yóu wán
sentences.english: Perhaps, if Cao Cao could have chosen his own era, he would have preferred to be born in the Tang Dynasty and been a true poet like Li Bai.
Then he wouldn’t have needed to fight and would have been free to write poetry, drink, and travel instead.

sentences.simplified: 无论人们如何评价，曹操的诗歌和成就都被历史铭记。
sentences.traditional: 無論人們如何評價，曹操的詩歌和成就都被歷史銘記。
sentences.pinyin: wú lùn rén men rú hé píng jià cáo cāo de shī gē hé chéng jiù dōu bèi lì shǐ míng jì

sentences.simplified: 他不仅是一个军事家、政治家，更是一位真正的文艺青年。
sentences.traditional: 他不僅是一個軍事家、政治家，更是一位真正的文藝青年。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù jǐn shì yí ge jūn shì jiā zhèng zhì jiā gèng shì yí wèi zhēn zhèng de wén yì qīng nián
sentences.english: Regardless of how people evaluate him, Cao Cao’s poetry and achievements have gone down in history.

sentence_translations: Cao Cao: A Literary Youth in a Turbulent Age
Cao Cao is a very famous figure in Chinese history.
He was a politician and military strategist during the Three Kingdoms period, and also a poet at the same time.
In the hearts of many, he was a smart, ambitious, yet intimidating person.
However, if we look at Cao Cao as a poet, we can discover a different side of him:
a scholar who was passionate about literature and cared for the people.
Cao Cao was born in the year 155 AD.
When he was a child, he was very clever and often managed to deceive his friends, so everyone called him “Cao the Deceiver.”
He enjoyed reading military books, practicing martial arts, ..
.. and also liked helping others solve problems, making him somewhat well-known locally.
At the age of twenty, he went to Luoyang to take up an official position, responsible for managing law and order in the city.
He worked diligently, but many officials in the court liked using money and connections to obtain positions, which disappointed him.
Later, he was promoted several times and also dismissed several times. This was his experience in his official career when he was young.
When Cao Cao was in his thirties, the Eastern Han Dynasty was already in great turmoil.
A minister named Dong Zhuo had control over the emperor, and the lives of the common people were becoming increasingly difficult.
Cao Cao used his own money to organize an army, intending to defeat Dong Zhuo.
But the war did not go well, and the country remained in chaos.
Seeing the suffering that war brought to the people, Cao Cao was very saddened and wrote a famous poem, “Ballad of the Graveyard”:
“White bones lie bare in the fields; for a thousand li no rooster crows.
Of a hundred people, only one remains; thinking of this breaks one’s heart.”
This says that the fields are covered with the white bones of those who died in battle, ..
.. and within a thousand li, not even the crowing of a rooster can be heard.
Almost all the people have perished, and thinking about this makes one feel very sad.
This poem expresses Cao Cao’s hatred for war.
It also strengthened his determination to unify the country, allowing the people to live a peaceful life.
In his fifties, Cao Cao had already become the most powerful person in the north.
He assisted the emperor in governing the country, defeated many opponents, and ultimately unified the north.
Some people say he was a bad person because he made the emperor obey him.
However, he believed he was saving the country and allowing the people to live a stable life.
After one war, Cao Cao went to the seaside and, seeing the vast ocean, felt very stirred.
He wrote another famous poem, “Viewing the Ocean”.
This includes the lines: “The sun and moon’s journey seems to emerge from it; the Milky Way is brilliant, as if coming from within.”
This poem describes the magnificent scenery of the sea, while also expressing Cao Cao’s grand ideals and steadfast confidence.
He hoped to be as vast as the ocean, leading the country towards peace.
Cao Cao not only enjoyed writing poetry himself, but also encouraged others to write essays and compose poems.
He supported scholars and recruited many outstanding poets to join his team, such as Kong Rong and Chen Lin.
The style of their works is very unique and is known as the “Jian’an style”.
They express the sorrow and heroic spirit of the people of that era.
Cao Cao’s poetry is not as complex as the rhapsody form which came earlier, ..
.. but rather features concise, vivid language and a strong sense of rhythm.
His poetry not only influenced the literature of his own time but also had a significant influence on Tang poetry, which came later.
After Cao Cao’s death, many people had different views about him.
Some say he was a treacherous minister because he seized power from the emperor.
Others say he was a hero because he helped unify the north of the country, reducing warfare.
He was a hero on the battlefield and a scholar in poetry, changing history with his army and expressing his emotions through poetry.
Perhaps, if Cao Cao could have chosen his own era, he would have preferred to be born in the Tang Dynasty and been a true poet like Li Bai.
Then he wouldn’t have needed to fight and would have been free to write poetry, drink, and travel instead.
Regardless of how people evaluate him, Cao Cao’s poetry and achievements have gone down in history.
He was not only a military strategist and politician but also a true literary youth.
